rights_signal: CC0 / Public Domain Mark / explicit unrestricted OA
notes: Store rights URI and OA flag per record; do not infer openness for unflagged records.

rights_signal: CC BY / CC BY-SA / other explicit reuse license
display_policy: full image allowed with required credit
iiif_embed_allowed: yes if license travels with manifest
notes: Preserve license label, URI, attribution text, and source link.

rights_signal: No known copyright / related RightsStatements.org URI
display_policy: full image only if statement permits and source terms align
notes: RightsStatements.org labels help but do not replace provider terms.

ingest_policy: metadata + source link + optional thumbnail pointer
notes: Never infer image reuse from public record visibility.

rights_signal: aggregator metadata plus provider rights field
display_policy: link to provider unless object-level rights verified
notes: Aggregator metadata may be open while partner objects are not.

display_policy: IIIF/embed only unless reuse rights are clear
notes: IIIF is a presentation layer, not a discovery substitute.

display_policy: manual review required for image reuse
notes: Respect privacy, community protocols, and contributor rights.
Index holdings and reading-room info; request permissions case by case.

rights_signal: archived URL / capture timestamp / platform terms
ingest_policy: URL + capture timestamp + archive source metadata
display_policy: link only unless archive provides lawful embed/thumbnail
notes: Store viewport, version, and capture context where available.

display_policy: do not ingest binaries; link to source/specimen
notes: Catalog names, foundries, versions, and specimens; never copy font binaries without permission.
